records.text: Indiana universities participated in human experimentation, and the government manufactured LSD in Indiana for experiments
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The universities in Indiana were factually involved in experimentation. In fact, Indiana was actually the place that the government manufactured the LSD to drug people with for their experiments.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Declassified records support Indiana-linked MKULTRA research and an Indianapolis pharmaceutical source for LSD, but saying the government itself manufactured LSD in Indiana overstates the evidence.
